title: Largest files by prefix
hints: Filter first, then sort: collect the `(name, size)` pairs where `name.startswith(prefix)`.
Two orderings in one sort: `key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0])` puts the biggest size first and breaks ties alphabetically.
Slicing handles both edge cases: `ranked[:n]` returns everything when `n` is too large and `[]` when `n` is 0.
`return [f"{name}({size})" for name, size in sorted(matches, key=...)[:n]]`, where `matches = [(name, size) for name, size in self.files.items() if name.startswith(prefix)]`.
